import html def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML response by inserting the user-provided content into a predefined template. The function safely escapes any HTML special characters in the user input to prevent script injection and other content‑injection attacks. Args: visitor_content (str): The raw user-provided content that will be embedded into the HTML response. Returns: str: The final HTML string with the escaped user content inserted. """ # Basic HTML template with a placeholder for user content html_template = """ Visitor Page

Welcome Visitor!

{user_content}
""" # Escape the user content to neutralize any HTML/JS that could be injected. safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
